plainTranslation: Steadying and heavy at once. The Saturn person grounds the Sun person's direction - anchor, mentor, ballast - or controls and dampens it. Built to last; can feel restrictive. Failure mode: a parent-child slide where one criticizes and one shrinks. Honesty about the weight keeps this a commitment instead of a cage; if it's shrinking you, say so.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry aspect material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
